newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CSR timber mill preservative leaks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CSR timber mill preservative leaks.

text.p: Building products and sugar group CSR Ltd said on Thursday that about 6,000 litres of a timber preservative had leaked from a storage tank at CSR's sawmill near the small town of Dartmoor in Victoria last weekend.
But CSR said it did not anticipate the leak would have a financial impact.
The leak of about 6,000 litres of a 2.5 percent solution of copper chrome arsenate came from a small hole in an underground storage tank at the mill near the town, which has 300-350 people.
"Borehole testing by groundwater experts is being conducted. Until results are known, the Health Department has recommended that residents not use local water," CSR said.
"CSR does not anticipate that the incident will have a material financial impact on the company," it said.
